text:
miri: New customer hit 402 on first call using quickstart. Console shows 'Set payment method' but quickstart language implied free trial.

alex: Can you paste the curl/SDK and workspace id so we can reproduce?

miri: workspace rdw-startup-77. curl used: curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-1.0\",\"input\":\"hello\"}'
Response: {\"error\":{\"code\":402,\"message\":\"Workspace payment method required: workspace rdw-startup-77\"}}

sam: This is expected after the onboarding policy change: prod-tier models require a payment method now. We should update quickstart to recommend a preview model for immediate success.

miri: Which preview model should we show in docs?

sam: Use redwood-mini-preview for trials. It's not gated and offers a small free token allowance for demos. Example Node snippet to override model is short and safe.

jess: Filing a product ticket to add console tooltip: "Production models require a payment method; use redwood-mini-preview for a trial call." Also adding an FAQ entry for CS.

alex: Devex actions: (1) add preview fallback to quickstart, (2) include a troubleshooting blurb for 402, (3) add SDK snippet showing model override.

miri: I pushed a tiny docs patch with the preview example and the 402 troubleshooting note. Testing now...

miri: switched to redwood-mini-preview and got 200: {\"id\":\"resp_01\",\"output\":[{\"content\":[{\"type\":\"output_text\",\"text\":\"hello!\"}]}]}

devex-bot: Runbook link added to onboarding guide -> https://go/release/runbooks/onboarding-billing-blocks

sam: Good catch. Also adding an internal CS note about the policy change so reps can explain. :thumbsup:

jess: Follow-up created for product-flag to allow one sample call for verified org domains; cc @alex-pm.

miri: Closing thread; quickstart PR link in comments.
